secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Stripe secret key for real payments; without it bookings use mock payments.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key for real booking emails; without it emails are logged instead of sent.

secrets.name: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. Sender address used with Resend (defaults to bookings@resend.dev).
